test_strategy.rationale: The requirement specifies a numeric threshold for temperature deviation (up to 3 degrees Fahrenheit) before triggering a deviation error. According to the guidance rules, requirements containing a numeric range or threshold map directly to equivalence partitioning (partitioning deviations into <= 3°F where no error is reported and > 3°F where an error is reported) and boundary value analysis (testing values right at and around the 3°F boundary).

test_cases.title: Temperature deviation exactly at upper boundary (3.0°F)
test_cases.preconditions: THEMAS system is running and actively monitoring thermostat temperatures.
steps: Induce actual measured temperature to 73.0°F (3.0°F positive deviation).
Observe THEMAS system reporting for any deviation error.
test_cases.expected_result: No deviation error is reported by the THEMAS system.

test_cases.title: Temperature deviation just above allowed boundary (3.1°F)
test_cases.preconditions: THEMAS system is running and actively monitoring thermostat temperatures.
steps: Induce actual measured temperature to 73.1°F (3.1°F positive deviation).
Observe THEMAS system reporting for any deviation error.
test_cases.expected_result: A deviation error is reported by the THEMAS system.

test_cases.title: Temperature deviation just below allowed boundary in negative direction (2.9°F)
test_cases.preconditions: THEMAS system is running and actively monitoring thermostat temperatures.
steps: Induce actual measured temperature to 67.1°F (2.9°F negative deviation).
Observe THEMAS system reporting for any deviation error.
test_cases.expected_result: No deviation error is reported by the THEMAS system.

test_cases.title: Valid equivalence partition: deviation well within allowed 3°F threshold
test_cases.preconditions: THEMAS system is running and actively monitoring thermostat temperatures.
steps: Induce actual measured temperature to 73.5°F (1.5°F deviation).
test_cases.expected_result: The system operates normally without reporting a deviation error.

steps: Induce actual measured temperature to 77.0°F (5.0°F deviation).
test_cases.expected_result: The system detects the excessive deviation and reports a deviation error for the thermostat.
